Apply Frobenius co-multiplication to split the unified type into True and False Belnap branches.
Anchor the True arm with the affirmative state of structural closure.
Anchor the False arm with the negative state of gate blockage.
Hold the B-state paradice where both True and False are simultaneously admissible without explosion.
Apply Frobenius multiplication to reconstitute the True and False branches into the original unified type.
Chain the 12 primitive ordinals sequentially into a complete 12-tuple structural type.
Execute forward morphism promoting the type up the tier lattice toward O_∞.
Execute contravariant descent to decompose the type into its bulk and boundary primitive seams.
Permanently fix the imscribed 12-tuple into the 17,280,000-element Crystal catalog.
Seal the terminal boundary of the Crystal, completing the self-modeling closure.
